narrative.synopsis: Eurystheus persecutes the children of Heracles, who flee with Iolaus and seek refuge at Athens. Macaria sacrifices herself, Hyllus arrives with an army, and Iolaus borrows Hyllus' chariot in battle; the wider section later ends with the Heraclidae obtaining the Peloponnesus.

narrative.centralConflict: The Heraclidae need protection from Eurystheus and his demand for their surrender.
narrative.resolution: Athens resists, Macaria offers herself as a sacrifice, Hyllus arrives, and Iolaus helps in battle.
narrative.outcome: The larger source section ends with the descendants of Heracles obtaining the Peloponnesus.
